name: specpin
description: Author and pin living business specs onto the elements of a running web UI, and number UI screenshots for the specshot editor.

interface.shortDescription: Pin business specs to a live web UI, and number UI screenshots
interface.longDescription: Specpin is a Git-native knowledge layer that attaches living business specifications to the elements of a web UI you already have. This plugin bundles two skills: 'specpin' authors and validates schema-valid .specs/*.spec.json files and drives the specpin sidecar CLI; 'number-ui-image' numbers the components of a UI screenshot and exports an annotated copy plus a bbox JSON that round-trips into the specshot editor. No application code is generated.
defaultPrompt: Write specpin specs for the elements on my login page.
Run specpin validate and fix any schema errors in .specs/.
Number the components in this UI screenshot and export an annotated copy.
